value.rationale: Radial regularization of noncompact inner composition commutators has a natural quantitative question: how much trace/Schatten spectral mass is created before reaching the noncompact limit? The exact coefficient is not determined by the operator norm or individual numerical ranges. Its dependence on the cyclic closure of an interaction phase yields an arithmetic discontinuity, plus a distinct Hilbert--Schmidt resonance. The zero-commutator boundary can still hide a positive operator-norm defect and divergent trace mass. This is a motivated operator-ideal and approximation-topology classification, not just a recomputed monomial action.
